components.name: Existing primitives and trust owners
components.detail: SourceContent already supports retained content and specialist recovery. LayoutCard owns persistent heading/surface. Button/CopyButton own focus and clipboard behavior; SeverityBadge owns severity tokens; Text/Caption/Code own typography; FadeIn owns reduced entrance motion; DataSourceNotice/DataFreshness own source-level feedback; deriveDataState distinguishes fatal from refresh errors.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: A single fatal query failure is rendered in the summary and all three cards, plus the PageContainer source notice. Page tests explicitly expect a working retry in every section at SchemaDriftPage.test.tsx:184. This is source-confirmed repeated messaging, not four independent failures.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep all four persistent shells and every recovery path; coordinate one primary source explanation with concise section-specific unavailable context. Preserve existing recovery assertions until a reviewed equivalent interaction contract exists.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Tables/columns/indexes intentionally appear in summary, both fingerprints and breakdown. Shared schemaPresentation already owns delta formatting and tone; local FingerprintStat and CategoryRow own distinct presentation roles.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Preserve all views; do not remove the comparison/detail inventory as duplication. If category metadata changes, consider one typed feature-local descriptor without moving queries or creating a competing global metric engine.

issues.detail: Current and expected hash buttons share the same accessible name. CopyButton's explicit ariaLabel also overrides its automatic Copied name (CopyButton.tsx:135-139); this caller does not request a toast or handle clipboard errors. Default sm is h-9; header refresh defaults to h-10, below the stronger 44px target default.
issues.fix: Give each caller a localized context-specific name and request existing withToast or onCopyError feedback. Review mobile target sizing via existing Button sizing/classes and preserve keyboard reachability; shared owner should retain success announcements even with explicit ariaLabel.

states.loading: Page shells persist. deriveDataState initial drives summary loading and card skeletons (two 150px fingerprints, 150px breakdown, 72px guidance). No measured verdict is displayed without drift.
states.empty: Missing drift shows unmeasured summary and specialist fingerprint/breakdown/guidance prerequisites. Fingerprint empty body offers refetch; other panels rely on header refresh.
states.fatalError: Generic failure passes source.fatalError to four local QueryErrors; source notice remains in page shell. Every retry is the same query.
states.unsupported: Any ApiError status 503 with no retained data is treated as unsupported; local error is suppressed, page adds unsupported explanation and retains empty section shells.
states.retainedRefresh: deriveDataState keeps payload on refresh failure; only fatalError enters section state. Summary labels retained evidence on stale or active refresh. Hashes/counts/guidance remain available.
states.offline: Shared DataSourceNotice and deriveDataState are the existing owners. Paused initial query remains loading locally; paused retained query becomes stale in deriveDataState. SourceNotice resolveDataSourceStatus reports a retained paused query ready unless other flags fail; header freshness depends on query flags. Actual offline presentation is unverified.
states.partialUnknown: Counts and deltas render dashes rather than zero; match badges require finite deltas. Drifted guidance distinguishes missing counts from hash-only drift. Wire types declare required counts, but presentation guards partial evidence.
states.success: Clean and drifted verdicts, signed positive/negative/zero deltas, hash-only guidance and exact copyable hashes.
states.disabled: Copy disabled for empty hash; refresh remains actionable while fetching, icon spins.

issues.detail: The unsupported branch checks only HTTP 503, not SUBSYSTEM_NOT_CONFIGURED. Other 503 outages could be described as an absent subsystem. dataSources is suppressed in that branch but query remains on PageLayout, allowing an Error freshness chip alongside Feature not supported.
issues.fix: Classify using the established typed error code when present and retain a fallback outage path; coordinate unsupported metadata with the shared freshness/source owner rather than masking all 503 failures.

visualIssues.detail: Three arbitrary category hues (cyan tables, emerald columns, amber indexes) add decoration without severity meaning; card header icons also use fixed cyan. Success/warning icons use fixed pale semantic hues without a light-theme mapping. Scoped scan found ten fixed cyan/emerald/amber-300 occurrences. No neon, fixed-white, glow or inline styles found in the six scoped files.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing neutral/icon tokens for category decoration and existing semantic token treatment for verdicts, retaining icons and labels. Measure composed theme contrast; do not invent a palette.

visualIssues.detail: The same Current schema vs recorded seed hint repeats in description, scope, status metric detail and three delta descriptions; scope also carries a long bounds caveat in the brief's metadata row.
visualIssues.fix: Retain provenance and the genuine timestamp/bounds limitation while presenting shared context once, with field-specific descriptions rather than repeated caption noise. Do not hide the limitation or current/expected counts.

architectureIssues.detail: A shared layout implementation imports UI primitives from the category barrel; OperationalBrief.tsx:3-12 and OperationalNarrativeDetails.tsx:2 also do this. Contract calls for concrete imports inside shared owners to avoid transitive chunk cycles; no cycle is proven by this audit.
architectureIssues.fix: Shared owners should use concrete internal primitive imports in their separately assigned scope. Page category imports are already correct; do not patch owners in a page task.

architectureIssues.detail: SchemaKpis supplies neither narrative nor attention. OperationalBrief.tsx:103-118 defaults cause/recommendation/evidence to unavailable, and its drawer at lines 284-301 says No current attention items even when the page verdict and guidance report drift. The generic drawer does not carry this source's concrete interpretation and bounds caveat.
architectureIssues.fix: Pass existing typed narrative/attention props based on the same drift evidence and conditional guidance, keeping unscored confidence and unknown cause explicit. Preserve the drawer and all metrics; do not invent evidence records or a confidence score.

priority.rationale: Strong shared composition and retained-data preservation already exist. Prioritize truthful unsupported/source feedback and drawer parity; next reduce repeated metadata and decorative hue, then validate touch targets and responsive layouts. No runtime defect acceptance is claimed.
